title: Bad Bunny | Biography, Music & News | Billboard
content: Bad Bunny, born Benito Martínez Ocasio on March 10, 1994 in Puerto Rico, is 5'11" tall. The article reports that he joined a church choir at age 5 and began posting songs to SoundCloud under the name Bad Bunny by 2016, which attracted Rimas Entertainment founder Noah Assad. His debut studio album, 'X 100PRE', was released in December 2018 and peaked at No. 11 on the Billboard 200. The article notes that his first Hot 100 entry was 'Krippy Kush' with Farruko, Nicki Minaj, Rvssian and 21 Savage, reaching No. 75 in January 2018. His first No. 1 hit was 'I Like It' with Cardi B and J Balvin from Cardi B's 'Invasion of Privacy', topping the chart in July 2018. Subsequent albums include 'YHLQMDLG', which peaked at No. 2; 'El Ultimo Tour del Mundo', which hit No. 1 and became the first all‑Spanish language album to do so; and 'Un Verano Sin Ti', which topped the all‑genre Billboard 200 for 13 weeks and became the top album of 2022. The article states that 'Un Verano Sin Ti' earned a 2022 Grammy nomination for Album of the Year, the first Spanish‑language nomination in that category, though it lost to Harry Styles' 'Harry's House'. He has also won awards for Best Latin Pop or Urban Album for 'YHLQMDLG' and Best Música Urbana Album for 'El Ultimo Tour del Mundo'. The article lists his collaborations with artists such as Drake, Travis Scott, The Weeknd, Dua Lipa, Becky G, and Rosalia.

title: Most-streamed songs of 2025 -- the surprise hits nobody expected | Music Day
content: The most-streamed songs of 2025, according to Kworb's global music data analysis, highlight unexpected hits that dominated Spotify and YouTube. The top song was 'DtMF' by Bad Bunny, with over 1,076,787,357 streams on Spotify and more than 185 million views on YouTube. Bad Bunny led the list with five songs in the top 10: 'BAILE INoLVIDABLE' (865,780,214 streams), 'NUEVAYoL' (696,580,293 streams), 'EoO' (616,246,335 streams), 'VOY A LLeVARTE PA PR' (594,087,337 streams), and 'VeLDA' (561,392,335 streams). Other top tracks include 'La Plena (W Sound 05)' by W Sound, Beéle, and Ovy on the Drums (703,425,130 streams), 'Golden' by HUNTR/X (692,770,666 streams), 'Love Is Gone' by SLANDER (290 million views on YouTube), and 'Abracadabra' by Lady Gaga (579,439,278 streams). The article notes that International Music Day is celebrated annually on October 1, and the data reflects global streaming trends in 2025. All metrics and song details are sourced from Kworb and Spotify, with YouTube view counts cited for official music videos.

title: Bad Bunny to be named Billboard's Top Latin Artist of the 21st Century - UPI.com
content: Bad Bunny is set to be named Billboard's Top Latin Artist of the 21st Century at the 2025 Billboard Latin Music Awards on October 23, 2025, in Miami's James L. Knight Center, airing live on Telemundo and streaming on Peacock. The honor recognizes his historic consistency on Billboard's Top Latin Albums and Hot Latin Songs charts throughout the first 25 years of the 21st century, with his albums and singles repeatedly topping the charts and setting a new standard for Latin music. This accolade follows his recognition as Spotify's most-streamed artist worldwide for three consecutive years and his record for the highest-grossing tour in a single year. Bad Bunny will also headline the Super Bowl LX halftime show on February 8, 2026, in Santa Clara, California. According to UPI, the announcement was published on October 9, 2025, at 14:00.

title: 2025 Billboard Latin Music Award Finalists Announced | Billboard News
content: The 2025 Billboard Latin Music Awards finalists have been announced for the October show. Bad Bunny tops the list with a record‑breaking 27 entries, including Artist of the Year, Global 200 Artist of the Year and Hot Latin Song of the Year for his smash hit 'DtMF' (source: Billboard). California’s Fuerza Regida follows with 15 mentions, notably Hot Latin Song of the Year for 'Tu Boda' with Óscar Maydon. Puerto Rican star Rauw Alejandro has 14 mentions, including Top Latin Album of the Year for his album 'Cosa Nuestra'. Colombian artist Karol G and Mexican act Tito Double P each have 10 mentions, while Peso Pluma has nine. The awards will air live on Telemundo on October 23, 2025, and the article encourages viewers to tune in for performances, fashion, and the final results. The piece was published on September 10, 2025, by Billboard.

title: Efecto Super Bowl: Bad Bunny vuelve a la cima de Spotify
content: Bad Bunny has returned to the top of Spotify's Global Daily Top Artists list following the successful conclusion of his Puerto Rico residency concert series, 'No Me Quiero Ir De Aquí.' His recent album and consistent presence on global playlists have driven a new peak in daily listeners. His iconic album 'Un Verano Sin Ti' has surpassed 20.6 billion streams on Spotify, making it the most-streamed album in the platform's history. Bad Bunny is set to headline the Super Bowl halftime show on February 8, 2026, at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. In a statement on Apple Music, he expressed pride in his culture, Puerto Rico, and the global Latin community, reaffirming his status as the leading Latin artist in global music.

title: O fenômeno Bad Bunny: como ele levou a música latina ao topo do mundo
content: Bad Bunny, born Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio on 10 March 1994 in San Juan, Puerto Rico, began singing in his church choir at age 5 and later pursued audiovisual communication at the University of Puerto Rico before dropping out to work in a supermarket while writing music. He self‑described himself as not a musician, saying, 'Não sou músico. Considero músico quem toca um instrumento musical, e por tragédias da vida não toco nenhum.' His early releases on SoundCloud attracted DJ Luian, leading to a contract with the independent label Hear This Music. In 2016 he released the single 'Soy Peor', and in 2017 he had 15 songs on the U.S. Hot Latin Songs chart. His debut album X 100PRE (2018) earned a Latin Grammy for Best Urban Music Album. 2019 saw the surprise album Oasis with J Balvin. 2020 brought two albums—YHLQMDLG and El Último Tour Del Mundo—making the latter the first all‑Spanish album to top the Billboard 200. 2022’s Un Verano Sin Ti, a 23‑track project, became the most‑streamed Spotify album of 2022 and 2023 and earned a Latin Grammy for Best Urban Music Album; its World's Hottest Tour generated approximately $435 million, the highest‑grossing tour by a Latin artist to date. 2023’s album nadie sabe lo que va a pasar mañana debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and set a Spanish‑language streaming record on Spotify. 2025’s DeBÍ TiRAR Más FOToS topped Billboard’s Top Streaming Albums and reached 152 million streams in its first week. Bad Bunny’s career also includes acting roles in Bullet Train (2022) and a cancelled Marvel spin‑off, as well as political activism such as the 2020 protest against the murder of a trans woman and the founding of the Good Bunny Foundation. The article presents these facts in a narrative style, citing specific dates, chart positions, and revenue figures, and includes direct quotes from the artist and collaborators.

title: Se crearon 25 mil nuevas listas de canciones en Spotify durante la residencia de Bad Bunny
content: Spotify announced that during Bad Bunny’s residency "No Me Quiero Ir De Aquí" at the Coliseo in San Juan from July 11 to September 14, 2025, about 25,000 new playlists were created with the artist’s name or "Puerto Rico" in the title. The residency drew roughly 460,000 attendees over ten weekends, and Spotify reported a 7 % rise in global streams from the United States. In Latin America, Mexico emerged as the top country, with Mexico City, Santiago, Bogotá, Lima, and Guatemala City among the most streamed cities. In the U.S., New York and Miami led city streams, while California and Texas topped state streams, reflecting the residency’s cultural reach. Micro‑trends such as playlists titled "Acho PR" grew 29 %. The residency also boosted other Puerto Rican artists: Chuwi saw an 18 % increase in new listeners in the U.S., including a 38 % jump on July 12, the second residency date; Los Pleneros de la Cresta, who collaborated on "Café con Ron", saw a 46 % rise in support. Guest artist RaiNao gained 26 % more followers on the residency start date, July 11. Songs like "Veldá" with Dei V and Omar Courtz, "Alambre púa", and "Baile Inolvidable" became instant anthems. Surprise appearances also generated spikes.

title: Bad Bunny será reconocido como el "Artista del Siglo 21" en los Premios Billboard
content: Bad Bunny will be recognized as the 'Artist of the 21st Century' at the Billboard Awards, according to a statement highlighting his unprecedented dominance of Billboard's Top Latin Albums and Hot Latin Songs charts over the past 25 years. His multiple multi-platinum albums and singles have broken records and redefined success in Latin music. The recognition underscores his global influence beyond music, extending into film, fashion, and pop culture. Bad Bunny became the first Spanish-speaking artist to headline Coachella, and his 2025 Puerto Rico residency show 'No me quiero ir de aquí' became the most-watched single-artist performance in Amazon Music history. He has also led Spotify's global most-streamed artist rankings for three consecutive years and holds the record for the most-attended tour in a single year. Additionally, he will make history as the first solo Latin artist to headline the Super Bowl 2026 halftime show. His cultural impact is further evidenced by his Billboard cover and 13 international magazine covers. The awards ceremony will be broadcast live on Telemundo on Thursday, October 23, 2025.

title: Bad Bunny lidera la lista Billboard de los 100 artistas latinos más grandes del siglo XXI
content: Billboard has named Bad Bunny the most influential and successful Latin artist of the first 25 years of the 21st century, ranking him at the top of its 'Top Latin Artists of the 21st Century' list. The ranking evaluates artists based on cumulative performance on two key Latin music charts: Top Latin Albums and Hot Latin Songs, covering the period from January 2000 to December 2024. Bad Bunny, whose real name is Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, achieved this distinction through a meteoric rise: he entered Billboard charts only in 2016 and within less than a decade reached 14 number-one hits on Hot Latin Songs and eight on Top Latin Albums. Billboard highlights that he holds the record for the most songs in the top 10 of Hot Latin Songs with 89—more than double the total of his closest competitors, Enrique Iglesias and Luis Miguel. Additionally, Bad Bunny was named the top artist globally in 2022 and has been recognized as the top Latin artist for five consecutive years from 2020 to 2024. The list includes Romeo Santos, Daddy Yankee, Enrique Iglesias, Marco Antonio Solís, J Balvin, Shakira, Aventura, Juanes, and Ozuna in the Top 10. This recognition is part of a special series by Billboard commemorating the first quarter-century of the 21st century, which will include upcoming lists for the best Latin albums, songs, and producers.

title: 25.000 nuevas listas de canciones se crearon en Spotify durante la residencia de Bad Bunny - El Aragueño
content: Spotify announced that during Bad Bunny’s residency at the Coliseo de San Juan from 11 July to 14 September, roughly 25 000 new playlists bearing the names 'Bad Bunny' or 'Puerto Rico' were created (Spotify press release, 2025). In the ten weekends the artist performed before about 460 000 attendees, U.S. streams rose 7 % (Spotify, 2025). Mexico emerged as the top country worldwide, with the largest city‑level streams in Mexico City, Santiago, Bogotá, Lima and Guatemala City (Spotify, 2025). In the U.S., New York and Miami were the leading cities, while California and Texas were the top states, reflecting the residency’s cultural reach beyond the island (Spotify, 2025). Micro‑trends such as playlists titled with 'Acho PR' grew 29 % (Spotify, 2025). Collaborators also saw gains: Chuwi’s new listeners in the U.S. increased 18 % overall, including a 38 % jump on 12 July; Los Pleneros de la Cresta rose 46 % on the same day; RaiNao gained 26 % followers on 11 July; Wisin and De La Ghetto added 41 % and 19 % new U.S. listeners respectively (Spotify, 2025). Songs like 'Veldá' (Dei V & Omar Courtz), 'Alambre púa' and 'Baile Inolvidable' became instant anthems of the residency (Spotify, 2025).
